I'm a late adopter to Overwatch and though I've got my own quibbles with it, I've become an addict.

This is my first competitive season and I'd like to hear you veterans' thoughts on it.

My wishlist:

* Tie SR earned more closely to individual skill - this is critical for us unfortunate solo queuers who get stuck on a losing streak with a bunch of idiots. I can carry the shit out of the team, get 4 golds, and still lose 400 sr in one night. That seems profoundly unfair to everyone who doesn't have 5 reliable friends to play with of a similar skill level.

* Ban serial quitters - it's insane how many people drop if their team loses point A, leaving the rest of their poor team to play 6 vs 4 for at least a few more minutes or be penalized. Serial quitters should be banned from competitive play, there's just no excuse for that kind of behavior.

* Keep overly skilled players from sneaking into low SR matches - it's easy for me to get in a group with a bunch of people ~500 SR lower than me and get into games where I almost single-handedly clean up the other team, who is also ~500 SR lower. That is profoundly unfair to the other team, who is expecting to play people closer to their skill level. The SR window for matchmaking should be narrower - 200-300 SR at most - or some special balancing needs to take place so that the higher SR person on an overall low-SR team isn't ruining the other teams' fun.

Those are just the ones I can think of now. If Blizzard can get matchmaking into a more balanced state a la old school Halo, they could greatly improve everyone's competitive experiences.
